Farm.title: Farm
Farm.description: Represents a farm with its location and settings.

country.description: Country where the farm is located.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application with roles and farm access.

displayName.description: Display name of the user, typically first and last name.

familyName.description: Family name, typically for farm owners.

idCardNumber.description: Identification card number, typically for farm owners.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login.

role.description: Role of the user (e.g., admin, vet, owner).

Animal.title: Animal
Animal.description: Represents an animal in the farm.

tagId.description: RFID tag identifier for the animal.

species.description: Species of the animal (e.g., bovine, ovine, camelid).

dob.description: Date of birth of the animal.

ageMonths.description: Age of the animal in months (derived).

status.description: Status of the animal (e.g., active, sold, deceased).

lastPregnancyDate.description: Date of the animal's last pregnancy.

currentWeightKg.description: Current weight of the animal in kilograms.

milkYieldAvgL.description: Average milk yield of the animal in liters.

vaccinationDueOn.description: Date when the next vaccination is due.

healthFlags.description: Health flags associated with the animal.

ForSaleAnimal.title: ForSaleAnimal
ForSaleAnimal.description: Represents a denormalized animal that is for sale.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: Represents an event related to an animal.

type.description: Type of the event (e.g., scan, intake, milk).

Consultation.title: Consultation
Consultation.description: Represents a consultation for an animal.

HealthRecord.title: HealthRecord
HealthRecord.description: Represents a health record for an animal.

recId.description: Unique identifier for the health record.

diagnosis.description: Diagnosis for the animal's health condition.

severity.description: Severity of the health condition (e.g., low, med, high).

recordedAt.description: Timestamp when the health record was recorded.

Vaccination.title: Vaccination
Vaccination.description: Represents a vaccination record for an animal.

vxId.description: Unique identifier for the vaccination record.

doseMl.description: Dosage of the vaccine in milliliters.

route.description: Route of administration for the vaccine.

givenAt.description: Timestamp when the vaccination was given.

nextDueAt.description: Timestamp when the next vaccination is due.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a message in a chat thread.

threadId.description: Unique identifier for the thread containing this message.

role.description: Role of the message sender (e.g., user, assistant, system).

species.description: Species related to the message (context for symptom checker).

suggestion.description: Suggested diagnosis or action from the assistant.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was created.

Alert.title: Alert
Alert.description: Represents an alert for a specific event or condition.

type.description: Type of alert (e.g., vaccination due, sickness).

dueAt.description: Timestamp when the alert is due.

status.description: Status of the alert (e.g., open, ack, closed).

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore data structure is designed to ensure security, scalability, and ease of debugging, following the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, and QAPs. Authorization Independence is achieved through denormalization of farmIds into the User document, eliminating the need for `get()` calls in security rules. The structure segregates data based on ownership and access requirements, enhancing security and simplifying rules. A denormalized `for_sale` collection is introduced to simplify public queries for animals for sale, avoiding complex and insecure collection group queries in security rules. Access control is enforced by leveraging path-based ownership for user-specific data and a membership map approach (via the user.farmIds array) for collaborative data. Explicit state modeling is used with a dedicated `status` field for entities like `Animal` and `Alert`. This approach ensures that list operations are secure, as rules can be written to filter data based on the denormalized `farmId` and user roles without needing to read other documents. The structure uses hierarchical paths to represent the relationships between entities (e.g., `/users/{userId}/farms/{farmId}/animals/{animalId}`), facilitating simple and efficient security rules based on ownership and role. The design also promotes data clarity and predictability by using explicit state modeling, a predictable schema, and consistent naming conventions.
